description: Use this when the person asks which countries Superpass covers, or you need a country's code for get_chip_location. Give words to find a country by name. Not for one country's details: use get_chip_location. Answers the countries Superpass has researched, each with its code, its name and where the chip is in its passport in a few words; only the ones whose name has the words, when given.

words.description: words of a country's English name, or its two-letter code

name: list_countries
title: List countries
